en: Dependent on a wholesome state that has the Path as its object, there arises a non-wholesome state that does not have the Path as its object by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; under predominance condition there are six ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Dependent on a wholesome state rooted in the Path, there arises a non-wholesome state that is not rooted in the Path by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a wholesome state dominated by the Path, there arises an unwholesome state not dominated by the Path by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six in root, six in dominance … pe … six in non-disappearance.
